query.description: The visitor's question, e.g. 'when does it start?'

actions.description: Get full, live details for "WebMCP Community Workshop" — the event shown on this page: date/time, venue, and CURRENT ticket availability (each ticket type with price, remaining quantity, per-order limits, sold-out state), plus a one-line gist. Read-only; call it to answer "are tickets still available / how much / when" before registering. For the full description, schedule, directions or FAQ, use ask_site. No input needed.

Look up an existing ticket order for "WebMCP Community Workshop" by order code AND purchaser email — both required. The order code starts with "o_" and appears in the confirmation email's order link and in the order page URL (/checkout/…/o_…/summary). Read-only. Returns status, tickets and totals only when the email matches the order; completed orders also open the order confirmation page for the user. Use it for "where is my confirmation / did my registration go through".

order_reference.description: Order code from the confirmation email link or order page URL, e.g. "o_AbC123…". (The short "Order Number" like O-XXXXX cannot be looked up.)

email.description: Email address the order was placed with.

actions.description: Search the public events listed by WebMCP Community on this site. Read-only. Returns upcoming events by default, soonest first (set include_past=true for past events); optional keyword query matches event titles/descriptions (any keyword may match). Each result has event_id, title, start date, venue, ticket price range and page URL — pass event_id to get_event or register_for_event. Opens the organizer's events page so the listing is visible. An empty result means no listed event matches.

query.description: Optional keywords, e.g. 'javascript' or 'workshop'. Omit to list all.

include_past.description: Set true to search past events instead of upcoming ones.

actions.description: Register the visitor for "WebMCP Community Workshop" (the event on this page; no event_id needed) by placing a real ticket order through the site's own checkout. THIS PLACES AN ORDER — call only after the user asked to register and confirmed ticket type, quantity and their name/email. Free tickets complete immediately: the order is confirmed and the page navigates to the order confirmation. Paid tickets reserve the order with the visitor's selections and navigate to the site's payment step, where the user pays (the agent never handles payment). If the ticket type is sold out but the organizer runs a waitlist, the visitor is added to the waitlist instead (using their name/email) and notified by email if a spot opens — nothing is charged. If it is sold out with no waitlist, or the quantity is unavailable, nothing happens and the response says why. Returns the order reference or waitlist status and next step.

ticket.description: Ticket type to book — name (e.g. 'General Admission') or ticket id from get_event.

email.description: Buyer's email — the tickets/confirmation are sent here.

attendees.description: Optional per-attendee details when booking multiple tickets; defaults to the buyer's details for every ticket.
